#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

long long compute(long long n) {
    if (n == 0) return 0;
    long long base = 0, count = 0;
    while (base * 10 + 1 <= n) {
        base = base * 10 + 1;
        ++count;
    }
    long long option1 = count * (n / base) + compute(n % base);
    long long option2 = count + 1;
    n = 10 * base + 1 - n;
    option2 += count * (n / base) + compute(n % base);
    return min(option1, option2);
}

int main() {
    long long number;
    cin >> number;
    cout << compute(number);
    return 0;
}
